intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Amity Patna vs Patna Women's College is not a single winner. Amity Patna is listed as private and Patna Women's College as public.

sections.heading: Amity Patna vs Patna Women's College for BA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Amity Patna if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹4 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹2.71 lakh, in a private BA setting at Patna.
Choose Patna Women's College only after you have checked the official BA brochure, because our records for fees or placements on this page are thin.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹2.71 lakh as a programme total for B.A Journalism & Mass Communication at Amity Patna.
We do not hold a quotable programme total for Patna Women's College that clears the fee floor on this page, so do not budget from a raw minimum row.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Amity Patna's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹7 LPA on Bachelor of Arts (Hons) Business Economics. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Patna Women's College here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Amity Patna on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Patna Women's College on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Bihar. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Amity Patna is listed as a private institute and Patna Women's College as a public institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a documented flagship placement year, Amity Patna is the clearer record here, because Patna Women's College has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
Patna Women's College is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded BA offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Amity Patna or Patna Women's College?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Amity Patna and Patna Women's College differ in more than one way: one is listed as private and the other as public. Check official fees, the admission test and the latest placement report before you choose.

faqs.answer: our records list ₹2.71 lakh for Amity Patna on B.A Journalism & Mass Communication; we do not hold a quotable fee for Patna Women's College on this page. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Amity Patna and Patna Women's College?
faqs.answer: Amity Patna's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest package of ₹7 LPA on Bachelor of Arts (Hons) Business Economics. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Amity Patna and Patna Women's College accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for Amity Patna, and no listed exam on this page for Patna Women's College. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
